agents.name: triage
agents.system_prompt: You are a support-ticket triage agent. When the user describes a ticket, call triage_ticket with the ticket text to get the department and whether a refund is requested. Then answer using the decision: route the ticket and say whether to escalate to a human. Keep your answer short.

department.instructions: Which team should handle this ticket?

refund_requested.instructions: Does the customer explicitly request a refund?

criteria.false: Does not ask for a refund

tools.name: triage_ticket
tools.description: Evaluate a support ticket and return its department and whether a refund was requested.
